versions.content: Relation between ValueSpecification and the defini- tion of CompuScale s In order to find a match between the content of a Val- ueSpecification and a CompuScale the content of the ValueSpecification shall be checked against the CompuScale Value Symbolic Name s according to [TPS_SWCT_01696]. If no matching CompuScale Value Symbolic Name s can be found then the Val- ueSpecification shall be considered unusable in the context of the CompuMethod that is subject to [constr_1146].
